career_ladder.salary_growth_trajectory: Direct recruitment through the APSSB Combined Graduate Level Examination (CGLE) appoints candidates as Upper Division Clerk (UDC, Post Code 14/26), Personal Assistant / Stenographer Grade-III (Post Code 12/26), and Librarian (Post Code 13/26) in Central 7th CPC Level 5 (₹29,200 – ₹92,300). Recruits in the ministerial cadre advance through the state civil secretariat hierarchy to Assistant Section Officer (ASO / Superintendent, Level 7, ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400), Section Officer (SO, Level 8, ₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100), Under Secretary (Level 11, ₹67,700 – ₹2,08,700), and Deputy Secretary (Level 12, ₹78,800 – ₹2,09,200) in the Arunachal Pradesh Civil Secretariat and directorates.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Stenography Proficiency Test (for Personal Assistant only)

papers.paper_name: Stenography Skill Test (80 wpm shorthand dictation for 5 minutes + 40 wpm transcription on computer in 45 minutes). Qualifying in nature. (For UDC and Librarian posts, Stage-1 is exempt and candidates appear directly in Stage-2 Written Exam).

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Objective Type Written Examination (OMR Multiple Choice)

papers.paper_name: General Awareness: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Current events, History, Polity, Constitution, Geography, Economics, Everyday Science, Arunachal Pradesh Specific GK)
General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Verbal and non-verbal reasoning, analogies, similarities, differences, problem solving, analysis, number series)

Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Number Systems, Simplification, Decimals, Fractions, LCM/HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentage, Average, Profit & Loss, Simple & Compound Interest, Mensuration, Time & Work)

Test of English Language and Comprehension: 25 Questions, 50 Marks (Error detection, fill in blanks, vocabulary, idioms & phrases, active/passive voice, direct/indirect narration, cloze test, reading comprehension)

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of original Degree certificates, 6-month Computer Diploma certificate, APST certificate, Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC), and identity proofs.

official_perks.description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of Basic Pay (₹16,936 per month on entry basic of ₹29,200 as of 01.07.2025) as adopted by Government of Arunachal Pradesh.
HRA at 9% of Basic Pay (₹2,628 per month for Class-Z stations in Arunachal Pradesh) or government residential quarter accommodation in Itanagar/district headquarters.
Special Duty Allowance at 10% of Basic Pay (₹2,920 per month) admissible to state government employees posted in the North Eastern Region / Arunachal Pradesh.
Transport Allowance of ₹1,350 per month plus 58% DA on TA (total ₹2,133 per month).
Location allowance for postings in tough or border circle administrative headquarters as per state finance norms.
Defined contributory pension under National Pension System (NPS with 14% Government contribution) and state government employee medical attendance reimbursement.
